jobs.title: Data Scientist II, Selection Growth Science
jobs.jd: Join us in shaping the future of Amazon’s Selling Partner business. The Selling Partner Selection Success organization is the growth and development engine for Amazon’s Store. We partner with product, engineering, science, and business teams to help Selling Partners identify promising product opportunities, make informed launch decisions, and grow new selection successfully. We combine comprehensive data, machine learning, experimentation, and seller insights to deliver actionable guidance at scale. We believe every motivated Selling Partner should have access to the tools and resources needed to build a successful and sustainable business on Amazon. We are looking for a Data Scientist II to develop science solutions for supporting end-to-end new selection success. Our vision is to connect selection guidance with opportunity/ASIN prioritization across pre and post launch. These solutions help Selling Partners understand unmet customer needs, link various demand signals with supply signals, assess a product’s potential before committing resources, improve product and listing decisions, and reach relevant customers after launch. Maintaining consistency across these stages is essential for earning Selling Partner trust and creating a continuous feedback loop between our guidance and actual customer outcomes. In this role, you will develop models and analytical frameworks that combine customer demand, on/off supplies, product attributes, comparable-selection performance, seller and brand signals, and early customer engagement. You will estimate product potential and uncertainty across different lifecycle stages, identify new products that offer distinctive customer value, and determine where Amazon interventions can improve discovery and conversion. You will work with large-scale behavioral, catalog, seller, and external-selection datasets across multiple marketplaces. The successful candidate will combine strong statistical and machine learning foundations with sound business judgment. You will translate ambiguous business questions into measurable science problems, develop and evaluate scalable solutions, and work with engineering partners to move them into production. You will collaborate with product managers, economists, applied scientists, and partner teams across Search, Pricing, Personalization, Listings, and Seller Experience. You will communicate findings and recommendations to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise and help shape the long-term science strategy for selection success. Key job responsibilities As an Data Scientist II in the team, you will: - Identify opportunities to improve SP growth and translate those opportunities into science problems via principled GenAI solutions . - Design and execute roadmaps for complex science projects to help SP have a delightful selling experience while creating long term value for our shoppers. - Work with our engineering partners and draw upon your experience to meet latency and other system constraints. - Be responsible for communicating our science innovations to the broader internal & external scientific community. - 3+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience - 2+ years of data scientist experience - 3+ years of machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance experience - Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment - Experience in Python, Perl, or another scripting language - Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company - Demonstrated experience leveraging generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency and productivity, with the ability to craft effective prompts and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs in a professional setting - Experience identifying opportunities to integrate AI solutions into products and services to drive business value Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Growth Alliance (all genders)
jobs.jd:
At HelloFresh, the goal is to change the way people eat forever by delivering high-quality food across 18 countries and 3 continents. As a global food solutions group and the world's leading meal kit provider, the portfolio includes HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, Factor_, and Youfoodz.

Engaging with HelloFresh in Warsaw means collaborating with HelloTech-a global technology division of over 1,000 people powering an end-to-end food ecosystem. From digital personalization, pricing, and forecasting to supply chain optimization and food waste reduction, technology drives every step of this direct-to-consumer model.

About the Role: What's in the Box

HelloTech operates in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each holding accountability for a specific product domain end to end. In this role, you will join an assigned squad, with the flexibility to transition between teams and projects as technical objectives and business priorities evolve.

Several high-impact machine learning domains are actively hiring, and your project and team placement will be aligned based on your individual strengths, interests, and expertise during the interview process. Key domains include:

  • Risk, Fraud & Payments (Growth Alliance): You will own production ML systems that protect HelloFresh from checkout fraud and intelligently recover failed recurring payments (such as Smart Payment Retry) via low-latency scoring on Databricks.
  • Personalization & Conversions (Growth Alliance): You will build real-time decisioning systems, customer win-back models, and scalable GenAI content pipelines that tailor journeys and messaging across visitor and customer funnels.
  • Dynamic Pricing & Customer Value Optimization (Growth Alliance): You will architect and scale the core Pricing Engine to drive pricing optimization and forecasting across 8 brands, 34 markets, and all weekly menus.

Across all domains, you will work on scalable, high-availability production ML systems serving global architectures. Please note that this is an individual contributor role and does not include people management responsibilities.

What You’ll Do: The Recipe

At HelloFresh, we are moving away from a model where engineers simply execute tickets toward one where product engineers are trusted to own customer problems. As a Product Engineer, you will take a problem, form a point of view, validate it with customers and data, and ship it using AI as a force multiplier.

  • Build and operate data products and machine-learning systems, taking them from experimentation through production and owning their real-world performance.
  • Architect and optimize scalable batch and streaming data pipelines (Python, SQL, PySpark on Databricks, Kafka), feature stores, and low-latency serving infrastructure.
  • Improve inference performance, reliability, and compute cost by profiling bottlenecks, right-sizing infrastructure, and maintaining tight latency targets with dependable fallback mechanisms.
  • Establish and raise modern MLOps standards across teams, including CI/CD automation, model registry versioning, infrastructure as code (Terraform), automated validation gates, and drift detection.
  • Design and execute rigorous experimentation frameworks from A/B tests and holdouts to off-policy evaluation-to credibly measure model impact on core business metrics.
  • Build and scale domain-specific applied AI solutions, ranging from real-time scoring and contextual bandits to production GenAI pipelines with automated quality gates.
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists, software engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to pressure-test models for production readiness, mentor teammates, and leverage AI coding agents (such as Claude Code or Cursor) to accelerate engineering delivery.

What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients

  • 5+ years building and operating live ML systems in production, paired with the statistical literacy to design sound experiments and interpret their results.
  • Hands-on experience building product-facing ML solutions directly tied to measurable business metrics (such as conversion, retention, revenue, or risk reduction).
  • Deep command of Python, SQL, and large-scale data processing (PySpark on Databricks), paired with solid software engineering practices (testing, clean code, version control) and familiarity with low-latency serving or backend languages like Go.
  • Hands-on background with cloud environments (AWS), containerization, automated CI/CD, and modern ML or orchestration tooling such as Databricks Model Serving, MLflow, SageMaker, Airflow, Kafka, or Terraform.
  • Practical, day-to-day fluency with AI coding tools (like Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot) beyond casual experimentation—knowing how to structure context and set clear boundaries on AI-generated work.
  • A quality-first mindset around model evaluation, drift monitoring, and A/B testing pitfalls for ML systems to ensure bad data or outputs never reach customers.
  • A bias to ship ("finishing the last twenty percent"), strong product sense backed by data, and clear communication skills across international, multi-disciplinary teams.

Nice to have:

  • A track record of optimizing data and ML pipelines for performance and cost at scale.
  • Experience with contextual bandits and off-policy evaluation.
  • Hands-on experience building and running production LLM pipelines.
  • Background in churn prediction and Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) modeling.
  • Prior experience in high-growth consumer tech or subscription-based businesses.

From claim notes and inspection reports to property photos, policy documents, call recordings, and correspondence, this role will focus on transforming complex information into actionable business value. As an early member of PURE's AI Engineering function, you will play a key role in building production-ready AI solutions, establishing engineering best practices, and helping shape the team's future capabilities. jobs.jd: If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/ About Us Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day. We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process. About the Role We're looking for a data scientist with strong statistics and modeling skills to be the science partner for the machine learning and recommendation systems behind Twitch's discovery products. You will work with product managers, ML engineers and applied scientists to help build what our recommendation systems should optimize for. That means balancing what a viewer does today (a click, a play, minutes watched) against what keeps them coming back: return visits, daily habits, and lasting connections with creators. It also means weighing short-form clips against long-form live content, and each surface against the others. This role will draw from a variety of statistical learning techniques, causal inference, optimization and recommender systems evaluation, and it still owns the full path from question to decision. Reporting to the Director of Data Science, you will work from our San Francisco, CA office. You Will - Help define the objective functions and success metrics for ranking and recommendations across feeds, search and notifications. Make the trade-offs explicit between short-term engagement (clicks, plays, watch time) and long-term outcomes (return visits, retention, new creator connections), including how short-form clips and live content add to or take away from each other. - Evaluate ranking, recommendation and feed changes with ML engineers and applied scientists. This covers A/B tests and long-running holdouts, offline metrics that predict online results, and the cost and value of exploration and cold start. Handle the hard cases: novelty effects, interference between experiments, two-sided marketplace effects involving creators and viewers, and feedback loops in recommendation data. - Build statistical and ML models that explain viewer behavior and size opportunities, such as propensity, uplift, survival and retention models. Include proxy metrics that predict long-term retention, so teams can decide in days rather than months. - Turn ambiguous product questions into clear analyses. Quantify the uncertainty, and make recommendations that inform the machine learning and discovery roadmap. - Define the logging and data needed to measure discovery surfaces, and check its quality. - Contribute to the team's standards for experimentation, causal inference and model evaluation, and share what you learn with other data scientists. Perks - Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance - 401(k) - Maternity & Parental Leave - Flexible PTO - Amazon Employee Discount About the team Twitch is all about community, and our Community team is a core pillar of what makes Twitch, Twitch. Community Discovery & ML (CDML) helps millions of viewers find the creators and communities they'll love. That covers search, browse, the mobile live and clips feeds, recommended notifications, and the recommendation systems behind them. When a viewer finds a new creator through one of these, it's often the start of a lasting connection. That connection is what keeps viewers, and the creators they watch, coming back. - 3+ years of data scientist experience - A BA/BS in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent industry experience. - 3+ years as a data scientist in a high-velocity, data-driven environment, with hands-on experience applying statistical modeling and machine learning (regression, classification, causal inference, time series), including the assumptions behind each method and when it fails. - Experience designing and analyzing online experiments, including variance reduction, power analysis and the pitfalls of interpreting results. - Expert SQL and proficiency in Python or R. - A track record of using data and models to influence product decisions and leadership. - An MS or PhD in a quantitative field. - Experience with recommender systems, search ranking or feed ranking, such as offline evaluation (precision and recall, NDCG), exploration versus exploitation, or cold-start problems. - Experience with multi-objective optimization or with defining objective functions for ranking systems, including choosing weights between competing goals. - Experience building proxy metrics for long-term outcomes, or estimating long-term effects from long-running holdouts or observational data (e.g., difference-in-differences, synthetic control, uplift modeling). - Experience with two-sided platforms or marketplaces, where changes for viewers also affect creators or supply. - Experience on a consumer content platform: streaming, short-form video, social or marketplaces. - Familiarity with Twitch, as a viewer or a creator (or both!). jobs.title: Sr. Applied Scientist, AWS Applied AI Solutions
jobs.jd: Join us if you're excited about pushing the boundaries of what's possible in physical AI, working with world-class scientists and engineers, and seeing your innovations deployed at scale. We are seeking an exceptional Senior Applied Scientist to drive technical innovation in visual reasoning foundation models. You will be a technical contributor and leader who helps shape the research direction, designs novel solutions, and delivers strong results that advance the state of the art while solving real-world business problems. You will help build a next-generation visual reasoning engine powered by frontier Large Video Models (LVMs). Your mission is to build a system that rivals human understanding of the physical world, moving far beyond the static perception of detection and tracking into the realm of deep spatial-temporal reasoning. This is not a passive computer vision tool; it is an agentic collaborator capable of interpreting natural language instructions, navigating unstructured environments, and executing complex tasks. You will work at the intersection of LVMs, LLMs, and Agentic AI, engineering systems that don't just 'see' but reason and act within the physical world. jobs.jd: At Parallel Domain, we believe that autonomous systems – from self-driving cars to contactless delivery drones – have the opportunity to drastically improve the quality of life for billions of people. We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to push our feed-forward reconstruction stack forward — from static 3D toward full 4D scenes over time. You will join a small, deep team where your technical judgment carries real weight from day one, and your work will ship in a pipeline customers depend on. What You'll Do Advance our feed-forward reconstruction models . Improve how we predict geometry, camera pose and appearance from real capture with transformer-based models, and extend it from static scenes to dynamic 4D. Train at scale . Run multi-node GPU training on large multi-view and video datasets, and decide what to scale, what to ablate and when a result is real. Define what "good" means . Build evaluation the team trusts for reconstruction quality, temporal consistency and geometric accuracy. Explore stronger priors . Investigate where generative models, such as pre-trained video diffusion, can help fill gaps the capture did not see. Land research in the product . Work with the pipeline engineers to get results into production, and care whether they hold up there. Track the field . This area moves monthly; form a view on where it is heading and argue for it. Strong PyTorch skills in a large shared codebase with real build and CI. Research judgment . Our platform connects every asset, coordinates every home and shapes thousands as one. Asset connectivity gives energy retailers one API for 1,000+ device models across 100+ brands. Home energy coordination turns that connection into smarter behavior at home, like charging an EV in the cheapest hours or using more of your own solar. Residential flexibility brings connected homes together into a dispatchable resource the grid can count on. Europe’s largest energy companies build on Enode : retailers, utilities and the teams that trade for them. The platform spans 1.7M+ connected households and 5,000+ MW of controllable load. We’re backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital and Creandum. The decisions made now will shape how the next grid gets built. A retailer's charging data arrives in several formats from a few legacy systems and their team has been blocked for weeks: you are the person who unblocks them. Every deployment should make the next one faster. In this role, you will: Own the technical delivery of customer deployments from discovery to production: understand the customer's architecture, scope the work, sequence it and flag blockers early Sit with customer architects and earn the right to change how their systems work Write production code in the customer's environment and in Enode, and know which is which. Build agents, harnesses, customer-facing MCP servers and tooling that make every deployment faster than the last Run your work with AI in the loop, and turn what works into something the team can reuse Turn what you see in the field into concrete ideas for product and engineering to become part of the core product Travel to customer sites for up to 50% of your time This role will be right for you if: You have 5+ years building and shipping production software, with real contact with customers or users, ideally as a forward-deployed engineer at large Enterprises AI is how you work by default, in and outside of work, and you can raise the bar of people who already consider themselves advanced You're technically credible with enterprise architects, including in messy legacy environments You get more excited by the customer's outcome than by the most elegant technical solution You're comfortable in high ambiguity and take ownership of large pieces of work You can tell a customer they are wrong, and be proven right You're genuinely interested in the energy transition Bonus: experience in energy, mobility or connected devices; early-engineer or founder experience; a forward-deployed background, for example at Palantir; fluency in another major European language What we offer: Opportunity to join and impact an early-stage climate tech startup with global aspirations as we scale. Dedicated time to build the skill, an internal skills library you can contribute to, and the tooling budget to work properly. Remote-first in Europe, with the option of attending an office in Oslo or receiving a co-working pass on demand. Three annual off-sites to connect with the team in exciting & fun places. Flexible, human-first culture. Stipend for setting up your home office. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ A few things to note: Enode is an equal opportunities employer. jobs.title: Machine Learning Fellow - Human Frontier Collective
jobs.jd:
The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think. We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including SciPredict, PropensityBench, and Professional Reasoning Benchmark.

Why join the HFC

HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.

  • Join a unique and exclusive expert network: You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions.
  • Participate in AI/ML projects: Beyond the collective network, you’ll be regularly invited to work on high-impact projects with Scale AI and its affiliated lab and platform: building AI safety and policy guardrails, helping models understand real-world deep learning workflows by designing, reviewing, and optimizing PyTorch models, evaluating complex ML code and AI-generated implementations for efficiency and correctness, and more.
  • Co-author selected research publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition.

Who should apply

  • Background: PhD, or postdoctoral research experience, in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field; or senior industry experience in Machine Learning or a related field.
  • Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and MLOps tools (Docker) and LLM frameworks (LangChain) is a plus.
  • Professional Mindset: Detail-oriented, innovative thinker with a passion for applied AI research and a commitment to collaboration.

How it works

  • Duration: This is a fully remote opportunity with no fixed end date; engagements continue as long as there's mutual interest. This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement. 
  • Work authorization: We do not sponsor visas for Fellows. To participate in the HFC Fellows program, you need to have or independently obtain full-time work authorization in the country you reside in. 
  • Community Network: Once you’ve received an invitation to join the HFC, you’ll also gain access to our newsletters, discussion channels, virtual sessions, IRL events, and much more.
  • Projects Logistics: 
    • Project selection: You’ll regularly get matched to carefully selected projects from our partners. Depending on the partner, projects range from evaluating AI models to designing experiments, building RL environments, co-authoring research papers, and more. 
    • Flexible schedule: There's no minimum commitment – you decide whether to take on a project. Most fellows spend 10–25 hours per week, on a schedule they set themselves.
    • Competitive pay: Project pay rates vary across platforms and depend on a number of factors, including but not limited to: projects, scope, skillset, and location. You’ll receive the pay information upon receiving project matching notifications.

Application process

  1. Apply: We review applications on a rolling basis.
  2. Interview: Candidates will get to discuss their research experience, professional background, and alignment with our mission to advance human-centered AI. Note: If we invited you directly, your invitation will say whether this step applies.
  3. Join the Collective: Successful candidates will receive an invitation to join the Human Frontier Collective Fellowship.

PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.

About Us:

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.

We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status.

jobs.jd:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Assistance Engineering team builds world-class tools for Airbnb's global network of support agents, so guests and hosts get a great experience 24/7, 365 days a year. Airbnb's operational staff must scale with our user base, and we own the entire tech stack behind their success.
Within Assistance Engineering, Assistance Foundations builds the shared platforms that support runs on: case management, the agent workspace, quality and coaching systems, money tooling, data services, agent routing, provisioning and training, and reliability.   • AI coaching that turns quality evidence into coaching plans for team leads
  • Simulation environments that train agents on realistic support scenarios
  • Natural language search and chat tools that help agents and supervisors find answers faster

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the LLM-based and agentic systems behind quality, coaching, case intelligence, and decision support for agents. The work spans prompt design, retrieval, fine-tuning, agent orchestration, dataset engineering, and evaluation. This is a product-building role: you will take systems from first experiment to production and own how they perform for real users.

  • Design, build, and ship LLM-based and agentic systems, from technical design through implementation, experimentation, and deployment.

  • Collaborate with product, design, engineering, data science, and support operations and quality teams to find high-impact problems and quantify results.
  • Participate in design and code reviews, and mentor other engineers.

  • Recent, hands-on experience building LLM-based systems that shipped to production
  • Expertise in designing and iterating on prompts, fine-tuning, and LLM evaluation
  • Expertise in RAG patterns, memory, tool use, and agent planning
  • Experience integrating LLMs with APIs, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks
  • A solid foundation in machine learning: modeling, evaluation design, experimentation, and A/B testing
  • A track record of shipping AI products used by real users, not only research prototypes or offline models
  • Strong programming (Python, Java, or Kotlin) and the engineering skills to productionize your own work: model serving, monitoring, data pipelines, and safe deployment
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively across teams and domains
  • Bachelor's and/or Master's/PhD degree, preferably in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

jobs.jd:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a senior researcher in GitLab's Threat Research group, you'll turn emerging security threats into protection for GitLab customers. You'll lead your own research projects, taking ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploying it, and analyzing the results. You'll also keep the detection systems you build running in production.

Artificial intelligence (AI) is central to how we work. We build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster. This is a full-stack research role: you'll combine an adversarial mindset with the software engineering skills to build and operate the systems behind your work.

What you’ll do

  • Lead your own research projects, from the first idea to the published result.
  • Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.
  • Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.
  • Analyze supply chain incidents and events.
  • Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.
  • Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.
  • Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.
  • Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.

What you’ll bring

  • Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with published findings such as Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) records, responsible disclosures, blog posts, or talks.
  • Experience researching AI agents, large language model (LLM) applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and using AI in real work through LLM application programming interfaces (APIs) or agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or agent software development kits (SDKs).
  • The ability to build systems and assess how to break them, with strong Go or Python skills and practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and maintainable code.
  • Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.
  • An understanding of package ecosystems and supply chain attacks, informed by current security and AI industry trends.
  • The ability to map attack vectors, explain trade-offs, and use data to move experiments forward while balancing quality, speed, and customer outcomes.
  • Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience.
  • Helpful but not required: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) experience, infrastructure as code with Terraform or OpenTofu, databases or data pipelines at scale, and reverse engineering.

You don't need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing (SAST) engines. A high-level understanding is enough.

You don't have to match every listed requirement exactly to be considered. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

About the team

The Threat Research group at GitLab researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab's dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. Recent work includes the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical RCE in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent. More on the Security Labs blog.

Expert-level proficiency in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript. Proven experience building an LLM agent harness . Experience utilizing reinforcement learning. Strong architectural skills with experience designing scalable, production-grade systems for machine learning applications. Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform and containerization technologies. A genuine interest in applying your technical skills to solve complex challenges in the mental healthcare space. North American business hours (Eastern time preferred), with daily overlap with colleagues in Europe (UTC to UTC+3). Based in Canada with the right to work there. jobs.jd: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Job Summary: This job will design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms to detect and prevent fraud across our Crypto and Debit Card portfolios. You will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, fraud strategy, risk operations, and product teams to protect customers and reduce losses through AI/ML solutions. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Develop and optimize machine learning models for various applications. Preprocess and analyze large datasets to extract meaningful insights. Deploy ML solutions into production environments using appropriate tools and frameworks. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into products and services. Monitor and evaluate the performance of deployed models. Minimum Qualifications: 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Experience with ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and tools for data processing and model deployment. Several years of experience in designing, implementing, and deploying machine learning models. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : Responsibilities: Develop and optimize ML models to detect fraud across debit card transactions (card-present and card-not-present), crypto buy/sell/transfer activity, account takeover, and scams. Deploy and maintain ML solutions in production, including feature pipelines, model serving, and champion/challenger testing. Collaborate with fraud strategy, risk operations, product, and engineering teams to integrate models into decisioning systems. Monitor and evaluate the performance of deployed models (fraud capture, false positive and decline rates, drift), making necessary adjustments and supporting retraining cycles. Produce model documentation that meets model risk management and governance standards. Contribute to team best practices through code reviews and knowledge sharing, and support the growth of junior engineers. Preferred Qualifications: Experience building fraud detection or risk models in payments, card issuing, banking, or crypto. Proficiency with gradient-boosted models (XGBoost, LightGBM); familiarity with deep learning approaches such as sequence models or graph-based methods is a plus. Understanding of card payment flows (authorizations, chargebacks, disputes) or crypto transaction and wallet risk. Familiarity with model explainability and governance in a regulated financial services environment. Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field. jobs.location: US, CA, Santa Clara US, Remote
jobs.jd: NVIDIA has helped redefine what computers can do. Now, generative AI is opening new possibilities for how people learn, create, and tackle problems. Realizing that potential means answering some of the hardest questions in AI: Where do models fall short? Which risks are we missing? How do we know our safeguards are working? As an expert in machine learning for Evaluations, you’ll help establish the evidence that guides the next generation of safer AI. Your curiosity and scientific judgment can shape what we test, what we learn, and what we build next. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer / AI Researcher / Data Scientist to join our AI Safety and Responsibility efforts within Enterprise Risk Management. Engaging directly in engineering tasks, you will apply your data science and statistics skills. You will turn open research questions into rigorous benchmarks, inventive experiments, and tools that reveal how multimodal large language models behave under pressure. Working with researchers and platform engineers, you’ll connect those discoveries to better training methods and safeguards, with reproducible results that inform technical reviews and executive decisions. If you love asking the question no one has thought to test, and building a convincing way to answer it, come help us define what progress in AI safety looks like. What You Will Be Doing: Safety Benchmarking: Design and maintain safety benchmarks for large language and multimodal models, translating risk scenarios into test cases, datasets, and scoring rubrics. Evaluation Methodology: Define metrics and protocols that assess safety alongside model usefulness, using baselines, uncertainty estimates, and failure analysis to distinguish meaningful improvements from noise. Reproducible Evaluation: Build reusable Python pipelines with versioned datasets, model configurations, and experiment tracking to reproduce results and compare performance across model releases. Automated Red-Teaming: Develop tools to discover failure modes and expand evaluation coverage, incorporating human review to validate automated scoring and provide additional judgment. Failure Analysis: Investigate model failures with researchers, document actionable findings, and develop regression tests to assess whether model changes resolve identified issues. Results and Communication: Partner with platform engineers to store and aggregate evaluation results, and clearly communicate findings, limitations, and emerging risks to researchers and decision-makers. What We Need To See: Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with 6+ years in the field of machine learning engineering or evaluation. Evaluation Design: Experience developing benchmarks, metrics, and statistically sound comparisons for ML systems, including selecting baselines and interpreting uncertainty. Ability to translate ambiguous evaluation questions into testable experiments. Engineering: Strong Python skills and experience building maintainable shared tools, data pipelines, and experiment-tracking workflows. Analytical Rigor: Ability to assess dataset quality, identify limitations in metrics and scoring methods, and support conclusions with reproducible evidence. Communication: Clearly explain findings and tradeoffs to researchers, engineering partners, and executives. Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd: Evaluation: Experience evaluating LLMs, multimodal models, or agentic systems through adversarial testing or automated red-teaming. Community Contributions: Contributions to public benchmarks or evaluation frameworks. Research Publications: A publication track record and interest in continuing to publish at top tier venues. Human-Aligned Evaluation: Experience validating model-based evaluators against human judgments or designing human-in-the-loop evaluation workflows. Statistical Rigor: Strong model evaluation skills and a commitment to sound statistical practices, including confidence intervals. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 187,500 USD – 364,000 USD for Level 4; and 232,500 USD – 442,000 USD for Level 5. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - CDI Paris - Theodo AI-Modernisation
jobs.jd: L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques. La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit ! Pourquoi on recrute un Forward Deployed Engineer ? Nos clients ont des systèmes legacy critiques, parfois vieux de 20 ans. Ils veulent les moderniser vite, sans casser ce qui marche. Pour y arriver, un bon outil IA ne suffit pas : il faut quelqu'un sur le terrain, au plus près des équipes du client, qui fait le lien entre leur réalité métier et nos agents et workflows IA. Le Forward Deployed Engineer est ce profil : à moitié ingénieur, à moitié consultant, et toujours responsable du résultat en production. Ton équipe : Tu rejoins la practice AI Modernisation et tu es détaché chez nos clients. Tu travailles avec un AI Architect, un Tech Lead, des Software Engineers et un Product Manager, et tu t'appuies sur une communauté tech de plus de 350 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes. Tes futures missions Être en immersion chez le client : comprendre son métier, son SI, ses contraintes et ses équipes, et repérer où l'IA a le plus d'impact Déployer et adapter nos workflows IA (agents, LLM, outillage de migration) sur le code et l'infrastructure du client Coder au quotidien : prototyper vite, industrialiser, mettre en production, et ne pas t'arrêter tant que la valeur n'est pas constatée Accélérer la modernisation du legacy : cartographier, refactorer et migrer avec l'IA, avec un haut niveau de qualité (Clean Code, tests automatisés, code reviews) Faire monter en compétence les équipes du client : pair programming, revues de code, transmission des pratiques AI-native Être la voix du terrain : remonter aux équipes produit et aux architectes Theodo ce qui marche et ce qui bloque, pour améliorer nos outils et nos standards Contribuer au business : repérer de nouveaux cas d'usage chez le client et aider à construire les propositions Exemples de projets HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d'une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L'objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l'IA, nous passons d'une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5. Pernod Ricard : modernisation d'une application interne de gestion des campagnes marketing, avec des millions d'euros en jeu. 23 semaines pour passer de Vue Express à React Nest, et connexion à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration. Ce que tu vas apprendre Devenir un ingénieur AI-native de haut niveau, capable de livrer avec l'IA sur des systèmes complexes en conditions réelles Développer une posture de conseil : cadrer un problème, convaincre des décideurs, piloter un changement Maîtriser tout le cycle, de la découverte du besoin jusqu'à la production Tes perspectives d'évolution Expertise : Tech Lead AI, AI Architect Avant-vente : Solution Architect Managériale : Engineering Manager Profil recherché Diplômé d'une top école d'ingénieur (Bac +5) 2 à 5 ans d'expérience en software engineering, idéalement en contexte client (conseil, ESN, startup en forte croissance) Une vraie pratique des LLM et des outils d'AI coding dans ton travail quotidien À l'aise sur une stack fullstack (Java / Spring Boot, Node / Nest, React / Next, Python) et curieux face aux environnements legacy Orienté client : tu aimes être sur le terrain, tu écoutes, tu reformules, tu sais dire non quand il le faut Ownership : tu te sens responsable du résultat, pas seulement du code Exigeant sur la qualité, tu sais arrêter la chaîne quand quelque chose ne va pas (#jidoka) Pédagogue, et excellente communication en français et en anglais Une méthodologie basée sur l'apprentissage continu Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d'une conviction forte : on développe d'abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits . Notre Lean Tech® System met l'accent sur l'apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l'objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour. Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? L’environnement : 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 🖥

jobs.title: Senior Machine learning Engineer
jobs.jd: As a Senior Machine learning Engineer in the Perception team, you will play a pivotal role in building and maintaining the backbone of our L2+ ADAS stack. This senior role calls for an experienced engineer who can think critically, execute independently, and deliver results on scalable deep learning infrastructure, optimize massive data ingestion pipelines, and ensure maximum efficiency across our compute clusters. You will be responsible for the entire DL infrastructure lifecycle—from managing Azure storage and hybrid Kubernetes clusters to designing efficient data loaders for multimodal training. You will work at the intersection of infrastructure, data engineering, and deep learning, enabling feature teams to train complex models (single frame, temporal, and multimodal) with speed and reliability. Your ability to solve abstract infrastructure challenges and apply "T-shaped" expertise—going deep in areas like infrastructure, multitask deep learning among others while maintaining breadth in software design—will be key to our success. Responsibilities Deep Learning Infrastructure & Compute: ●Manage and optimize the entire DL infrastructure, including Azure Blob Storage integration, VNET setups, and hybrid compute resources (Cloud and On-premise/Frankfurt clusters). ●Lead performance investigations and benchmarking for next-gen hardware (e.g., comparing H200 vs. H100, Azure native vs. deployment nodes) to ensure cost and speed efficiency. ●Maintain and scale Kubernetes clusters for training and inference workloads. Data Pipelines & Efficient Loading: ●Architect and develop high-performance data loaders for complex multimodal datasets (camera, radar, temporal/non-temporal data). ●Modernize data processing pipelines using Ray and Kubernetes to parallelize data caching, shuffling, and oversampling. ●Leverage PyArrow and SQL to optimize data consumption and integration with data loops. ●Implement efficient dataset update strategies (handling deltas) and ensure seamless integration of new tasks into the multimodal multi-task network. CI/CD, Monitoring & Quality: ●Design and maintain robust GitHub Workflows and CI pipelines for new and existing feature teams. ●Develop KPI dashboards using Grafana to monitor compute usage, GPU efficiency, unit test durations, and overall system health. ●Manage dependency updates (Torch upgrades, Ubuntu updates, Hydra maintenance, Dependabots) to ensure a secure and modern stack. ●Drive software design excellence by performing thorough code reviews (PRs) and enforcing high standards in software architecture. Embedded & Evaluation: ●Establish scalable evaluation pipelines for embedded targets, specifically for QNN boards and other edge devices. ●Collaborate with feature teams to support model compression experiments and on-target performance verification. Required Qualifications ●Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. An advanced degree is an advantage. ●Experience: 5+ years of industry experience in MLOps, Data Engineering, or Software Infrastructure, with a focus on Deep Learning systems. ●Programming & Software Design: Expert-level proficiency in Python with a strong emphasis on clean software design, object-oriented programming, and architectural patterns. ●Infrastructure & Orchestration: Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Cloud platforms (specifically Azure ML, Azure Storage/Networking). ●Big Data & Optimization: Proficiency with high-performance data processing tools such as Ray, PyArrow, and SQL. jobs.title: Research Engineer / Research Scientist, Post-Training — Collective Alignment (User Signals)
jobs.jd: About the Team The Collective Alignment (User Signals) team is a post-training research team working at the intersection of data science, human feedback, and reinforcement learning. We develop methods for learning from real-world user interactions to build AI systems that deliver lasting value, helping people learn, grow, and accomplish increasingly complex goals with ChatGPT. Learning from user feedback presents fundamental research challenges: signals are often noisy, biased, and difficult to interpret, and improvements in offline metrics do not always translate into better experiences for users. Our team develops scientific approaches to understanding these signals and translating them into improvements in model behavior through evaluations, reward modeling, and post-training. About the Role As a Research Engineer or Research Scientist, you will investigate how AI systems can learn from human feedback and real-world usage to better serve users over time. You will develop new approaches to extracting meaningful learning signals from complex user interactions and incorporating those signals into model training. This role requires strong deep learning research skills, scientific rigor, and curiosity about how people interact with AI. You will design controlled experiments and ablations, critically examine the relationship between offline evaluations and online model behavior, and work closely with research, product, and data science teams to understand whether improvements translate into meaningful value for users. In this role, you will: - Develop novel methods for learning from human feedback and user interaction signals. - Research approaches to incorporating feedback into reward modeling, reinforcement learning, and post-training. - Design rigorous experiments and ablation studies to isolate the effects of new data, objectives, and training methods. - Develop offline evaluations and investigate their relationship with online experiments and real-world user outcomes. - Analyze unexpected results, investigate discrepancies between evaluation metrics and user behavior, and develop hypotheses to guide further research. - Evaluate tradeoffs and regressions to improve targeted model behaviors while preserving broader capabilities. - Collaborate with research, alignment, product, and data science teams. - Implement and debug experiments across large-scale deep learning research systems. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have a strong background in deep learning research through academic or industry experience. - Have demonstrated research ability through publications or substantive research contributions in deep learning or LLM post-training. - Have experience developing new machine learning methods and evaluating them through rigorous, hypothesis-driven experimentation. - Think critically about experimental design, measurement, and what evaluation results do and do not establish about model behavior. - Are comfortable designing ablations, investigating surprising results, and reasoning about the relationship between offline metrics and real-world outcomes. - Have strong programming skills and experience working with complex ML codebases. - Are curious about how people interact with AI and how those interactions can inform better models. Nice to have: - Experience with RLHF, reinforcement learning, or modern LLM post-training. - Research or demonstrated interest in AI alignment, human feedback, or user signals. - Experience with online experimentation, evaluation methodology, or learning from noisy and biased feedback. - Experience connecting machine learning research with real-world product behavior. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, Alexa AI - ML Engineering
jobs.jd: Alexa Proactive, now powered by Alexa+, brings customers personalized, proactive content, suggestions and actions across Alexa devices and surfaces: news, sports, recipes, music, shopping deals and tips to discover new features. Behind these experiences are recommendation and ranking systems that anticipate what customers need and surface the right content, suggestions, or actions at the right moment, through the right channel. Deciding what to show, to whom, when, and through which channel, for millions of customers, is a large-scale recommendation and ranking problem, and much of its science is still ahead of us. We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to join ML Engineering (MLE) India in Bengaluru, part of the Personalization and Delivery Engineering (PDE) org in Alexa AI, and build the recommendation and ranking systems behind Alexa+ proactive experiences. You will be part of Proactive Science, a global science team across time zones, and set the scientific direction for your area: content retrieval and relevance, ranking and re-ranking, how the full page is composed, and how the system learns from customer feedback. You will work closely with Proactive Science partners and with the software and data engineers who run these systems in production. We value scientists who can move fast: iterate on algorithms quickly, validate ideas through rigorous online experiments, and turn them into measurable customer and business impact. As a senior scientist, you will frame ambiguous problems on your own, make sound trade-offs between model quality, latency and cost, and deliver end-to-end solutions to production with limited guidance. You will also mentor scientists and engineers, and influence engineering, product, and science partners across teams. Key job responsibilities - Science roadmap: Own the science roadmap for proactive recommendation and ranking. Turn customer and business goals into clear ML problems, plans and metrics. - Proactive recommendation and ranking: Design and scale multi-stage recommendation systems (candidate generation, relevance filtering, ranking, re-ranking, and delivery policy) that decide what to surface, to whom, when, and through which channel, for millions of customers across Alexa devices and surfaces. - Personalization: Move ranking from popularity to deep personalization, using customer interests, engagement history, context (time of day, device) and content understanding. Apply two-tower retrieval, cross-encoders, learning-to-rank, CTR/CVR prediction, and sequential and multi-task recommendation models. - Whole-page optimization: Optimize the whole page, not only the ranked list: slot rules, diversity, share of voice and backup content. - Objective design and alignment: Build multi-objective ranking and optimization frameworks that align model objectives with business goals and customer experience metrics, with guardrails against fatigue, dismissals and repeated content. - Rapid iteration to impact: Drive fast experimentation cycles from hypothesis to offline evaluation, online A/B testing, and launch. Continuously improve models based on customer feedback and online results. - Explore and exploit: Bring explore and exploit into the system through contextual bandits, counterfactual and off-policy evaluation. - ML foundations: Partner with software and data engineers to build a feature store shared by training and inference, feature data-quality checks, automated retraining with evaluation gates, and model performance dashboards (CTR, NDCG and business metrics). - Content understanding and generation: Use LLMs and embeddings to strengthen content understanding, topic tagging and representations for ranking, and contribute to the generation of proactive content. - Scientific rigor: Own the full science lifecycle with sound experiment design, counterfactual evaluation, and production accountability. Ship models within strict latency and cost budgets, with safe fallbacks (for example distillation and efficient inference). - Leadership: Mentor scientists and engineers, run science and design reviews, write clear documents for senior leaders, raise the hiring bar, and build reusable science components across teams. A day in the life A DAY IN THE LIFE No two days look the same, because many of the hardest problems are still open. You might start the morning with A/B results for a personalized re-ranker: clicks went up, but so did dismissals. You decide how to balance the two before you dial it up. Next, you take on a cold-start problem: a new content provider has no engagement history, so how should it earn a slot without hurting the page? With Proactive Science partners across time zones, you shape next half's roadmap: move from popularity ranking to deep personalization, replace fixed slot rules with a learned whole-page policy, add explore and exploit, and make retraining automatic. With software and data engineers, you work out how a larger model fits a tight latency budget, and what safe fallback serves when it times out. You end the day writing a short proposal that turns one open question into a plan the team can build. About the team ML Engineering (MLE) India, part of Personalization and Delivery Engineering (PDE) in Alexa AI, builds the personalization and proactive-intelligence systems that let Alexa anticipate what customers need before they ask. In Bengaluru, we own the AERO runtime, which selects and composes proactive content for Alexa devices, and CxT (Customer Experience Telemetry), which captures how customers see and engage with that content. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, Demand Tech, Amazon Ads
jobs.jd: In Amazon Advertising, we apply machine learning at massive scale to optimize the prediction, ranking, and bidding behind every ad - deciding, in milliseconds, which ads to show shoppers and how to value them. We're looking for an experienced Applied Scientist to lead a science area within how we rank, value, and bid on ads for Amazon DVA+ (Display, Video, and Audio) - including how we judge whether an ad is a good fit for the page a shopper is on and for the shopper themselves. It's high-scale, low-latency, customer-facing science: your models run live in front of millions of shoppers under tight real-time constraints. The questions are genuinely open - how do you tell whether an ad is relevant to someone, how do you balance what's good for shoppers, advertisers, and Amazon, and how do you keep getting that right as shopping behavior and inventory shift underneath you? You'll set the technical direction for how we answer them, and have room to shape where we take it. A few things make this stand out: your models touch a huge share of the ads shoppers see every day, so even small improvements add up fast; you'll run modern ML live under strict latency limits, across regions and very different types of ad inventory; and the problem space is rich - from how we value and bid on ads, to keeping models stable as traffic shifts, to what makes an ad a good fit for a shopper. Key job responsibilities - Be the scientific point of reference for your area, mentoring scientists and engineers and raising the team's bar through code, design, and science review. - Shape the science roadmap for your area, aligning partner teams and building consensus across science and business. - Advance the state of the art in ranking, deep learning, and information retrieval, judging which problems are genuinely new versus solvable with existing approaches, and set the standards the team builds on. - Own ambiguous problems end to end with limited guidance: frame them, break them down for yourself and others, prototype, experiment, and ship. - Define how the team weighs competing objectives — shopper experience, advertiser and publisher value, and Amazon's business — and the metrics that keep models holding up across placements and marketplaces. - Write and ship your own production code, moving fast with modern AI coding assistants and agents — we're all builders here. A day in the life You might start by digging into last week's experiment results, then use an AI coding agent to get your next prototype built and ready to test in production. In the afternoon you could be sketching a new way to measure ad relevance, reading a recent paper that bears on it, and reviewing a teammate's design - as you are the person the team turns to when a problem gets hard. You'll move between hands-on science, writing and shipping real production code, setting the direction for your area, and helping the scientists and engineers around you do their best work. About the team We're a group of scientists and engineers based in Edinburgh and London, working to make Amazon's ads more performant and relevant. We sit within a larger team spread primarily across New York City and the UK, and we have a broad mandate to build and experiment. You'll lead a science area within that mandate, with the data and infrastructure to do the work well and room to grow your scope over time - including opportunities to attend top conferences (NeurIPS, KDD, ICML). - PhD or equivalent research experience - Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language - Experience in applied research - Experience in building machine learning models for business application - Experience with Machine and Deep Learning toolkits such as MXNet, TensorFlow, Caffe and PyTorch - PhD in machine learning, statistics, mathematics, physics, engineering, computer science, operations research, econometrics, optimization, or equivalent quantitative field. - Experience in recommender systems, performance advertising, or online auctions. jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer – AI/ML Networking Disaggregated Inference, Annapurna Labs, Annapurna Labs
jobs.jd: Every token a large language model generates depends on data reaching the right accelerator at the right moment. As AI models outgrow any single chip, the network between accelerators becomes the bottleneck that decides how fast — and how affordably — the world's largest models can serve real users. That network layer is what our team builds. We're in search of an engineer to work at the frontier of disaggregated inference: splitting LLM serving into separate prefill and decode pools and moving the model's KV cache between them at the absolute limit of what the hardware allows. Get it right and users get answers in milliseconds; get it wrong and the fastest accelerators in the world sit idle waiting on data. You'll own pieces of the high-speed transfer path that make the difference, and you'll measure your success in how close you run to the theoretical peak of the machine. What we're looking for: Strong C/C++ and a love for low-level, performance-critical systems — solid command of Linux, kernels, memory, and writing fast code. The instinct to ask "how fast could this possibly go?" and the rigor to measure it. Experience with high-speed networking or HPC interconnects (RDMA, InfiniBand, libfabric, UCX, NIXL, MPI) is valued highly; embedded-systems experience is a plus. Prior AI/ML experience is welcome but not required — if you're a great systems engineer, we'll teach you the ML side. If you like solving genuinely hard problems, working shoulder-to-shoulder with HPC and ML customers, iterating fast, and shipping at a scale few places can offer, come join us. This is a role on the leading edge of AI/ML infrastructure. Key job responsibilities Build and optimize the low-level data-movement software across accelerators, servers, and heterogeneous memory — over AWS's highest-performance network fabric. Push performance to the hardware roofline: profile, find the real bottleneck, and close the gap between "it works" and "it runs as fast as physics permits." Work across the stack — from kernel and network transport up to the inference frameworks — and partner with teams building the chips, runtime, and models. Deliver features that run on our largest clusters, for our largest customers, serving the largest AI models in production. A day in the life Annapurna Labs, a crucial part of AWS, is responsible for developing hardware and software components for EC2 infrastructure. Our team focuses on building networking solutions that for Machine Learning (ML) and High-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads on AWS. We have mixed discipline orgs, you’d be working side by side with infrastructure experts, hardware engineers, RTL engineers, scientists & architects. Our workforce spans the globe and is truly international, you’ll find yourself working side by side with individuals from numerous countries. We take mentorship seriously, you can both expect senior mentorship and will be expected to mentor new and junior engineers. The pace is fast as we work on the latest advancements of AI/ML, but we take the time to bond as a team and enjoy the successes. We offer flexibility in working hours, and respect WLB as a core org tenet. The team enjoys working with numerous principal-level engineers and closely with directors, career growth opportunities are certainly available. This is a role where you will always be encouraged to keep learning, the AI/ML field is fast moving and constantly evolving. About the team You'd be joining Annapurna Labs, an integral part of AWS. Annapurna designs the hardware and software building blocks behind EC2 — every EC2 instance runs on hardware we designed. jobs.title: Research Engineer / Research Scientist, Human Flourishing
jobs.jd: About the Team The Human Flourishing team’s mission is to ensure AI systems understand and advance human flourishing. As AI becomes more capable and plays a larger role in people’s lives, we want its human benefits to grow with its capabilities. The Human Flourishing team is part of the broader Post Training organization. Our approach has two parts. Firstly, we measure and improve models’ understanding, capability, and propensity to act according to people’s values and to help them achieve their long-term goals. Secondly, we directly scale tangible impact for users in human domains like education and mental health, working across research, product, and partnerships to increase the benefits over a billion people experience weekly when they use ChatGPT. Our recent work includes Beneficial RL https://alignment.openai.com/beneficial-rl/, which investigates how training for beneficial behavior generalizes across settings, and MentalHealthBench https://openai.com/index/introducing-mentalhealthbench/, a benchmark developed with mental health experts to evaluate realistic conversations. About the Role We’re looking for an exceptional, hands-on researcher to turn difficult-to-define signals of long-term flourishing into measurable improvements in model behavior. You’ll help set research direction, build what is needed to test your ideas, and drive successful work into the models and products we ship. We’re especially interested in researchers with deep experience improving frontier models through pretraining or reinforcement learning (RL) / post-training, especially on less verifiable problems, or researchers who combine strong LLM skills with deep expertise in domains like education or mental health. Prior experience in these domains is not required. In this role, you will - Develop scalable training methods across the training stack that improve how models understand people’s values, support their agency, and help them achieve long-term goals. - Lead high-leverage research from an open question to a shipped improvement: choose a hard-to-define problem, iteratively define success, run experiments, and integrate into frontier models. - Build RL environments for difficult-to-verify outcomes, and study whether beneficial behavior generalizes across settings. - Create evaluations grounded in human expertise and feedback that reveal capability gaps, unintended incentives in RL, and failures that aggregate scores can miss. - Test whether measures of model behavior predict better learning, wellbeing, and other long-term outcomes, and use those findings to guide training. - Build new 0→1 capabilities in human domains that may have an increasing impact with upcoming increases in model intelligence and test-time compute. - Partner with product teams, engineers, partnerships teams, and domain experts to deploy promising methods, measure their effects in real use, and turn what you learn into further improvements. - Assess AI’s impacts on human flourishing at the scale of over a billion users.
