jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.jd:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level
  • Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field
  • Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on
  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments
  • EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools
  • UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments
  • Experience with datalinks and radio systems
  • Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, Last Hundred Yards
jobs.jd: Every doorstep is different. Our robot has to understand all of them. We're building robots to deliver packages to customer homes. To make that possible, we're creating a system that can automatically generate a simulation-ready digital twin of the outdoor delivery environment for every customer home Amazon delivers to; modeling the driveways, yards, walkways, stairs, porches, and doorsteps a robot must understand and navigate. And the goal isn't simply to create virtual worlds that look real. They need to be real in the ways that matter to a robot. Geometry, semantics, appearance, physical properties, and the varied environmental cues that influence perception, planning, and motion, must be reproduced faithfully so robot behaviors from the field are repeatable in simulation. Our simulator becomes an effective tool to study the problem. The same autonomy software that runs on the physical robot also runs in simulation. When robot behavior differs between simulation and reality, we can ask why, and improve the representation, simulation, or models that produced the difference. Our North Star ambition is a system capable of modeling the delivery environment for every customer home we serve, across the enormous diversity of real residential environments. There isn't an established recipe for doing this. We are advancing the knowledge frontier of scene reconstruction. The right representation may combine classical geometry, learned scene representations, generative models, world models, or approaches that haven't been invented yet. We're interested in people with deep expertise in one or more areas of: Computer vision, 3D graphics, scene reconstruction, physics simulation, neural scene representations, Gaussian splatting, generative AI, world models, or related areas - with a strong interest in applying that expertise to robotics. Role Overview This is applied research with a short distance from idea conception to physical consequence. You'll work closely with robotics, autonomy, simulation, and software engineers to turn promising methods into systems that change how real robots perceive, plan, and navigate at Amazon scale. As a Sr. Applied Scientist on the Last Mile Robotics team, you will develop cutting-edge methods for capturing, reconstructing, and simulating real-world delivery environments in high-fidelity 3D. Your work will directly enable autonomous robots to understand and navigate the diverse conditions found at customer doorsteps. You will push the boundaries of scene reconstruction, neural rendering, and generative modeling, transforming scientific breakthroughs into physical impact through rapid experimentation and close collaboration with robotics, autonomy, and simulation teams. - Experience in applied research - Knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++, Python, Java or Perl Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.jd: About Agon Agon is building Europe’s defence AI lab. We develop the sovereign infrastructure and AI foundation models to train, test and evolve autonomous defence systems, in Europe and for Europe. At the heart of it is a synthetic battlefield: a virtual testing ground where drones, vessels and other autonomous systems face adaptive adversaries at scale, and where their failure modes are exposed before they ever deploy. We work as a neutral partner to defence manufacturers and governments. Founded in London in January 2026, we’ve raised $100M to date. Our $70M Series A, at a $450M valuation, was led by Northzone alongside Lakestar, Lux Capital and XYZ, with backing from former Sequoia Capital head Roelof Botha. It was also the first joint investment by the UK Government’s Sovereign AI Fund and the National Security Strategic Investment Fund. Between them, our founders have helped build one of the defining defence-tech companies of the last decade, and started an aerospace company from scratch. Around them is a founding team hand-picked from Europe’s best engineers, each at the top of their field, and brought together to build this. We’re scaling fast across our offices in London and Berlin. The role As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll be the technical bridge between Agon’s AI development environment and our customers’ real-world model development workflows. You’ll work in small teams and own end-to-end delivery of high-stakes projects. You’ll embed with customers, working in their models, data and pipelines, and integrate our platform so their teams can build, simulate and validate AI systems at scale. Using our fast-evolving product suite, you’ll stand up in days a development environment that would take customers years to build in-house. Our FDEs come in different flavours. Some are strongest in software integration, others in modelling and simulation or AI. Every FDE works directly with customers, writes production software and builds a strong understanding of the defence domain. If you’re strong in software and with customers but new to defence, we’d still like to hear from you. This role is based in London, with regular travel to customer sites and our Berlin office, mainly within Europe. What you’ll do Deploy and integrate: work directly with customers to deploy and operationalise Agon’s AI development environment, connecting it to their models, data sources and pipelines. Solve broad technical problems: tackle software engineering, simulation and synthetic-data pipelines, ML workflows, cloud infrastructure and system deployment. Bridge systems: connect customer-built systems to Agon’s platform to deliver real value quickly. Build repeatable approaches: design architectures and ways of working that make customer projects consistent and scalable. Own outcomes: drive projects to completion, adapting as requirements and priorities change. Be the voice of the customer: feed real-world friction and needs back to our product and engineering teams. What you’ll bring A strong engineering background: ideally in computer science, robotics or a related discipline. Production software skills: proficiency in Python and at least one other production language, such as C++, Go, Java or TypeScript. Integration experience: you’ve helped integrate and deploy complex systems. Familiarity with AI and ML workflows: ideally including simulation, synthetic data, or model testing and validation. Customer focus: excellent communication, and experience driving customer engagements to success. Independence: you solve problems well and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. The right attitude: your references would describe you as low-ego, highly motivated, thoughtfully opinionated, a strong communicator and a curious listener. Willingness to travel: to work on site with customers and between our offices, mainly within Europe. Nice to have Experience in a forward-deployed, solutions engineering or field engineering role Aerospace or defence experience Deep expertise in modelling and simulation, or in AI, ML or optimisation such as reinforcement learning Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure), containers and CI/CD Experience with data engineering, MLOps or integrations with third-party systems What we offer We pay at the top of the market we compete in, and everyone is an owner. Pay: salary at the 90th percentile of the companies we compete with, benchmarked by role, level and location. Equity: every permanent employee holds options. New hires receive options worth their base salary, vesting over four years with a one-year cliff. Cash and equity choice: trade some salary for more options, or some options for more cash. Pension: 5% employer and 5% employee contributions on full base salary. Real impact: you’ll shape how Agon works with customers while our FDE team is still small. How we work Our values shape how we work: All as One Company, Take Extreme Ownership, Low Ego, Be Bold, and Remember Who We Serve. We prefer clear written thinking to polished slides, and we hold a high bar. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd:
We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to contribute to cutting-edge Research & Development. As innovators in speech technology, our mission is to Understand Every Voice - a vision that has propelled us to be world leaders of Voice AI. Fuelled by innovation, inclusivity, and a passion for making a global impact through world-leading Speech AI, we're looking for an experienced Senior Machine Learning Engineer to accelerate our efforts towards exceptional speech solutions.

Our Modelling Team trains diverse models, including large self-supervised ones, supporting Speechmatics towards being the most accurate speech recognition system globally. It also ensures their deployment into production, working with the latest developments in ML, but also with the best engineering practices for software engineering and model serving.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Work on complex R&D projects, with a diverse group of engineers, to achieve ambitious goals.
  • Stay current with the latest developments in Machine learning.
  • Execute high-impact projects to ensure team success.
  • Work collaboratively across departments and mentor team members (where appropriate).

Who we are looking for:

  • Demonstrated experience in collaboratively pursuing ambitious R&D agendas.
  • Precise attention to detail, but is also aware of how the big picture relates to company goals, and where the field of Machine Learning is headed towards.
  • Understanding of the modern Machine Learning stack, for example:
    - Knowledge of contemporary transformer architectures (e.g., GQA, KV-caching) and best practices.
    - Experience in distributed training techniques.
    - Familiarity with optimisation strategies for model inference (e.g., dynamic batching, flash attention, speculative decoding).
  • With preferred backgrounds covering some of the following:
    - Publications in top-tier conferences.
    - Contributions to popular open-source repositories.
    - Technical writing skills as evidenced by relevant publications or blogs.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not feel you match all of the requirements exactly. The list of requirements is intended to show the kinds of experience and qualities we’re looking for, but it is not exhaustive. If you are interested in the role, the team, and our mission, we would love to consider your application. We are always open to conversations and look forward to hearing from you.

Who we are:

Speechmatics is the leading expert in Speech Intelligence, and uses AI and Machine Learning to unlock business value in human speech worldwide. We work with an amazing mix of global companies, and our technology can integrate into our customers stack irrespective of their industry or use case – making it the go-to solution to harness useful information from speech.

Joining us means working with some of the smartest minds around the world, focused on cutting-edge projects and deploying the latest techniques to disrupt the market. We believe in putting people first; we’ll do all we can to help you develop your skills and give you the tools you need to thrive. Our Focus Fridays give you an undisturbed day of focus, offset with Together Tuesdays when we have our team meetings, so you've always got the right balance.

We have structured a hybrid approach that includes 2-3 designated office days each week. This arrangement ensures that while we embrace the advantages of remote work, we also maintain the vital connection and synergy that only in-person interactions can foster.

This is only the beginning; we’re looking for amazing people like you to continue our journey…

What we can offer you:

No matter what stage of your career you’re at - from paid internships and first-job opportunities through to management and senior positions - we’ll support you with the training and development needed to reach your career aspirations with us. There really is no shortage of opportunities here for you to get involved and collaborate with those around you to deliver your best work.

We offer incredibly flexible working, regular company lunches, and birthday celebrations. But that’s not all. We’ve spoken to our teams to find out what they want. From Private Medical, and Dental for you and your family, through to global working opportunities, a generous holiday allowance and pension/401K matching, we want to make sure our employees and their families are looked after. Every employee will receive a working from home allowance for tech or home office equipment (on top of your choice of laptop and accessories of course). Our approach to parental leave is designed to support employees globally. While this varies by geo, we have support in place for parents (including adoption assistance and reproductive health services) to ensure they have the time and financial resources needed to care for their growing families.

At Speechmatics, our mission is simple: Understand Every Voice out there. 

That's not just about our tech – it's the heart and soul of who we are. We welcome different experiences, viewpoints, and identities. For us, it’s not just the right thing to do; it’s our catalyst for sparking innovation and creativity. Our teams thrive in an environment that celebrates and supports everyone – no matter their gender, identity or expression, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, belief, marital status, national origin, veteran status, pregnancy, or maternity stat

jobs.title: Data Scientist – Optimization & Control
jobs.jd: Role You’ll improve and extend the decision logic behind our battery fleet. Our optimization already runs our batteries every day; now we want to make it sharper, more robust and ready for new use cases. Our batteries sit behind the meter at industrial sites, so every decision has to balance customer savings, grid constraints and market value under uncertainty. Our data scientists and quantitative researchers work as one team and often across each other's topics. What you will do The role covers two closely linked areas. You can work in either one and switch between them as priorities and your interests evolve: Fleet optimization: Plan how each battery runs over the coming hours and days, combining customer savings, grid fee rules and market value within each site's limits. Forecasts of load, PV and prices are generated and fed into the plan, which has to stay robust to their uncertainty. You also measure how much value we actually capture. On-site control: Make the plan work in reality. Within our local control system, you design the logic that executes the schedule at each site, reacts to deviations and falls back safely when data or devices fail, while hard limits such as grid capacity, feed-in restrictions and state of charge always hold. Topics you'll work on You join work that is already running and take ownership of topics as priorities require. These are the areas where we want to add strength: Improving and extending our optimization models for sequential decision-making on time series, across customer savings, grid fee rules and market value. Making decisions more robust to forecast uncertainty (load, PV, prices). Developing the on-site decision logic of our local control system: MPC, constraint handling and fallbacks. Making sure hard constraints always hold in operation: grid connection limits, feed-in restrictions, state of charge. Analyzing where we lose value compared to what was possible, and simulating new use cases before go-live. Bringing models into production together with our engineers. What we are looking for Strong in optimization or control under uncertainty, e.g. LP/MILP, MPC, stochastic or robust optimization, state estimation or Kalman filtering. Experience with, or at least exposure to, predictive modeling and machine learning, or a strong background in statistics. Good Python skills and the ambition to write clean code that runs in production, not just in notebooks. You don't need to be a software engineer by training, but you care about code quality and use AI tools to move fast. You are comfortable with messy real-world time-series data and team up with our data engineers to clean and prepare it for modeling. You think in constraints and failure cases and make pragmatic decisions without perfect requirements. You enjoy working closely in a small team, learning each other's topics and covering for each other. Nice to have: battery storage, microgrids or energy management; using probabilistic forecasts in decision-making; German energy markets and regulation. What it means to work at BEO We are a small team taking on a hard problem, and we hold ourselves to a high bar. We value ownership, direct and honest communication, and getting better every day. If you like solving complex problems, you'll fit right in. Our office is in central Munich. We offer plenty of flexibility but ask for an office-first commitment. People learn faster and get more done together. We offer a competitive salary, equity upside in the company, and top-notch equipment (you choose what you need). You'll join us early in our journey. The foundations are in place, but it's still essentially day one, with plenty of opportunity to shape how we tackle one of the most significant challenges of our time. Next steps We move fast. Most processes are completed within 2 weeks. Apply if this sounds like you. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, AWS Elemental
jobs.jd: AWS Elemental builds media services used by broadcasters, streaming platforms, and sports leagues to prepare, process, deliver, and monetize video. Elemental Inference is the applied machine learning team within that organization. We develop models that understand and transform live and file-based video, producing capabilities such as intelligent reframing, highlight detection, video enhancement, and contextual metadata for advertising and content discovery. Our work reaches customers through the same media workflows that carry major live events, always-on channels, and large on-demand libraries. As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will develop new machine learning approaches and carry the strongest ideas into production. Current work spans multimodal video, audio, and language models; spatial and temporal understanding; active-speaker and point-of-interest detection; scene retrieval; video super-resolution; and learned methods for improving compression. These problems rarely have a single accepted metric or a ready-made dataset. You will help define the task itself, determine what evidence is needed, and build evaluation methods that reflect the experience of people watching and working with the resulting video. This role combines applied research with the practical demands of a real-time media service. You will design datasets and objectives, train models at scale, run controlled comparisons, and investigate failures. You will also work closely with engineers to export, optimize, and deploy those models. A result is not finished when it performs well in a notebook. It must preserve its quality after conversion, fit within GPU memory, meet latency and throughput targets, handle the temporal behavior of live video, and operate at a cost customers can sustain. You will be a technical leader on the team as well as an individual contributor. The role calls for someone who can take an ambiguous customer problem, separate the scientific questions from the engineering constraints, and lead a team toward a defensible answer. You will review experiments and models, mentor other scientists and engineers, and improve the shared methods the team uses for training and evaluation. Strong judgment matters here. So does the ability to explain a complicated result clearly, including its limitations, to people from several disciplines. We welcome candidates with deep experience in computer vision, multimodal learning, video processing, or related areas. Direct media experience is valuable but not required. A scientist who has solved difficult problems in another field, understands how to test ideas rigorously, and wants to learn the video domain can also succeed in this role. Key job responsibilities Lead the formulation of ambiguous video problems into research plans with clear datasets, objectives, baselines, evaluation protocols, and production acceptance criteria. Develop models for multimodal video understanding and generation, spatial and temporal reasoning, detection and tracking, scene retrieval, video enhancement, and learned compression. Develop models for multimodal video understanding and description, spatial and temporal reasoning, detection and tracking, scene retrieval, video enhancement, and learned compression. Build evaluations that measure the behavior customers will see. Depending on the problem, this may include task accuracy, factual support, temporal localization, retrieval quality, perceptual video quality, rate-distortion performance, or human review. Take models from research code to production-ready artifacts. Partner with engineers on model export, reduced-precision inference, quantization, numerical parity, accelerator-specific optimization, and integration with serving systems and video pipelines. Balance model quality against latency, throughput, GPU memory, context limits, and operating cost. Diagnose problems across training stability, data quality, precision, compilation, serving, and live temporal behavior. Build reusable mechanisms for dataset management, experimentation, model comparison, regression detection, and performance measurement rather than solving each research problem in isolation. Review scientific work and production code. Identify weak comparisons, data leakage, unsupported conclusions, untested edge cases, and operational risks before they reach customers. Work with product managers, software engineers, and other scientists to make scope and design decisions. Use evidence to resolve disagreement and communicate what is known, what remains uncertain, and what further work is worth doing. Mentor scientists and engineers in experimental design, machine learning methods, video evaluation, and production ML practices. Contribute applied research through internal technical reports, patents, and publications at appropriate conferences or workshops. About the team AWS Elemental provides a portfolio of cloud media services built to prepare, process, deliver, and monetize video at global scale. Our technology supports some of the world's largest live broadcasts as well as 24/7 channels and on-demand content. The broader organization brings together expertise in video coding, image processing, distributed systems, advertising, and the operational demands of professional media. Elemental Inference applies machine learning across that video pipeline. The team works on video understanding and enhancement, contextual metadata, smart composition, event detection, retrieval, and compression. Some projects use large multimodal models that combine video, audio, and language. Others use specialized temporal or spatial models designed for a narrow task and a strict real-time budget. We choose the approach that fits the customer problem rather than forcing every problem into the same model family. Scientists on the team own more than model architecture. They build and govern datasets, develop annotation methods, train on distributed GPU infrastructure, and create evaluations

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/x) , you own that part. You'll work directly with our customers' sustainability, finance and IT teams, connect their systems to Tanso, and build the integrations, data pipelines and workflows that make the platform work for them. You'll write production code in our codebase, not workarounds next to it. And when you solve the same problem for a second customer, you'll make sure it becomes part of the standard product, so nobody has to solve it a third time. Key responsibilities Own customer implementations end-to-end, from scoping to go-live and the first completed reporting cycle. Build the integrations, features and workflows our biggest customers need to work with Tanso day to day. Ship them in our codebase together with our product teams. Connect Tanso to the systems customers already use, such as ERP systems like SAP, data warehouses or Microsoft 365, and make sure these connections work reliably. Build AI agents which take over routine implementation work, and share what works with the rest of the team. Run on-site workshops with sustainability managers, finance and IT. Your profile Hands-on experience in software engineering, solutions engineering or a technical implementation role. AI-native way of working: AI agents are an integral part of how you build and deliver. Strong communication skills, in writing and in person: You explain technical decisions in a way that sustainability managers, finance and IT teams all understand. Excellent German and English, spoken and written (C2): You run workshops and present to customers in German and work with our team in English, so both need to be at a professional level. Solid full-stack skills: You are comfortable working in an existing codebase and with external APIs. Product sense: You can distinguish what a customer asks for from what they actually need, and you build the simplest solution that solves it. Willingness to travel regularly to customers across the DACH region. What we offer A highly competitive compensation package with an attractive equity package to participate in Tanso's growth. Hybrid working model that combines the benefits of onsite collaboration with the flexibility needed. A company-contributed pension plan to support long-term financial security. Yearly budget to support ongoing professional development. Sponsored access to EGYM Wellpass to prioritize your wellbeing with thousands of options. Exclusive discounts that help you save on a wide range of everyday brands, services, and experiences. Our team We're a diverse group of people, and that diversity is what makes us great. We bring unique perspectives to everything we do and are always eager to learn from each other. We work in cross-functional teams to tackle ambitious challenges, actively seek feedback and be the best versions of ourselves. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI
jobs.jd: As an Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI for the Public Sector in Germany , you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities. You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of a Sr. Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. The Embedded Approach The Advisory Solution Consultant inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. What You’ll Do As the Advisory Solution Consultant, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. Key responsibilities include: Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown. Keep product demonstration minimal and purposeful — use it only to establish credibility and to set up the POV, never as a substitute for proving value on real data. Secure and scope a POV: earn customer sponsorship to engage in a hands-on cycle where we use their data to solve the identified problem with our Agentic workflow capabilities. Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results. Translate POV outcomes into an executive value narrative that quantifies impact and defines the path from a single proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. What We’re Looking For To succeed in this role, you should bring: Builder Mindset: A builder’s instinct — comfortable getting hands on with a customer’s data and environment to prove value directly, rather than relying on canned demonstrations. POV-Centric Selling: Proven ability to scope, sell, and deliver Proof-of-Value engagements that convert a single problem into quantified, data-backed outcomes. Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment to a POV. Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Agentic workflows and AI-driven automation, and how to apply them to CRM problems on live customer data. CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience, with strong knowledge of service, sales, lead & opportunity management. Enterprise Experience: Proven track record engaging large organizations and earning executive sponsorship for hands-on, data-driven engagements. Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate technical POV results into clear, business-oriented value stories for senior enterprise stakeholders. Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global teams spanning Sales, Product, and delivery. Language: fluency in English and German Qualifications Demonstrated experience building or delivering POVs, prototypes, or hands-on technical engagements — a hands-on track record of proving value on real customer data, not just presenting it. Hands-on experience applying AI and Agentic workflow capabilities to solve business problems — automating workflows, orchestrating AI agents, and analyzing AI-driven outcomes within CRM or adjacent enterprise contexts. 10+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience, with a clear shift toward Discovery-led, proof-based selling. Experience of selling into Federal / Public Sector organisations Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise with cloud software solutions. Experience working collaboratively with product management, product marketing, partners, and professional services. Track record of working with a Sales counterpart to promote execution excellence and advance transformational opportunities. jobs.title: Human Health Data Scientist/Radiation Epidemiologist
jobs.jd: Job Description: Analytical Mechanics Associates, Inc. (AMA) is seeking a ¼-time Human Health Data Scientist to support Epidemiology research efforts of the Space Radiation Group in the Durability, Damage Tolerance, Reliability Branch at NASA’s Langley Research Center in Hampton, VA. The epidemiologist will support analysis of epidemiological data and development of radiation risk assessment tools relevant to the astronaut cohort. The position allows for remote telework. Responsibilities: Assist in study design, data synthesis and analysis of morbidity and mortality datasets relatable to the astronaut cohort. Apply statistical expertise in the development of radiation risk prediction tools supporting human spaceflight applications. Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams in support of NASA mission objectives. Participate in the dissemination of research findings including internal communications, conference presentations, and peer reviewed publications. Required Experience: PhD in epidemiology 10+ years’ relevant research experience in statistics, biostatistics, and health science data analysis. Experience with morbidity and mortality analysis of astronaut cohorts Strong publication record and demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences. Desired Skills: Experience performing systematic reviews and meta-analyses relevant to spaceflight health. Demonstrated data science training experience. Proficiency using R and/or Python for robust statistical analysis. Familiarity with NASA space radiation risk models. Must be a US Citizen or US Permanent Resident. The salary range for this position is $125,000 to $150,000 per year, depending on relevant experience and education. Analytical Mechanics Associates (AMA) is proud of our customer relationships, our diverse and dynamic work environment, and our employees' career satisfaction. AMA is a small business with a wide reach; headquartered in Hampton, VA, AMA has operations in Greenbelt, MD; Huntsville, AL; Dallas and Houston, TX; Denver, CO; Mountain View, CA; and Edwards Air Force Base, CA. With over 60 years of experience, AMA specializes in aerospace engineering, science, analytics, information technology, and visualization solutions. AMA combines the best of engineering, science, and mathematics capabilities with the latest in information technologies, visualization, and multimedia to build creative solutions. We offer competitive salaries and a substantial benefits package, including but not limited to paid personal and federally recognized holiday leave, salary deferrals into a 401(k)-matching plan with immediate vesting, tuition reimbursement, short/long term disability plans, and a variety of medical, dental, and vision insurance options. AMA is committed to the professional growth of every employee, understanding that the successes of our employees drive our success. We provide a work environment that is engaging, collaborative, and supportive. To learn more about our company, please visit our website at and follow us on Facebook and LinkedIn. AMA is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic prohibited under federal, state, or local laws.
